title: ModelRouting
description: Model profiles in config/models/routing.yaml (blueprint section 14.4, ADR-0027, ADR-0028). A profile pairs a registered provider with one model; its provider-specific settings follow that provider's schema in schemas/config/model-providers/. Credentials and deployment endpoints are named by environment variable, never written here. The model gateway checks the provider, the settings and uniqueness at startup and in cargo xtask validate-config.

default_profile.description: The profile of agents that name none. SYNTH_MODEL_PROFILE overrides it.

prices.description: Prices per model for cost accounting. The cost of a call to a model without a price is unknown, never zero.

ModelProfile.description: One model behind one provider, selected by name. Only the fields every provider shares are fixed here.

provider.description: The name of a provider registered in the model gateway, such as openai_compatible.

tool_calling.description: False if the provider cannot return tool calls. Such a profile is refused at startup for an agent that has tools.

settings.description: Provider-specific settings, checked against the provider's schema in schemas/config/model-providers/.

EnvVarName.description: The name of an environment variable. Its value is read at startup and never logged.

ModelHeaders.description: Extra request headers. Values are configuration, not secrets: credential and protocol headers are rejected.

ModelRetryPolicy.description: Bounded retries of rate-limited, overloaded and timed-out calls, with exponential backoff.

max_attempts.description: Attempts in total, the first included.

max_backoff_ms.description: Upper bound of every wait, including one a provider asks for.
